import pandas as pd
import os

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs('outputs', exist_ok=True)

# Read the input matrix
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missing_counts = df[indicator_cols].isnull().sum()
missing_rates = missing_counts / len(df)

# Create missingness report
missingness_report = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_cols,
    'missing_count': missing_counts.values,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates.values,
    'kept': missing_rates <= 0.30
})

# Save missingness report
missingness_report.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_indicators = indicator_cols[missingness_report['kept']]

# Create selected matrix with only kept indicators
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]
selected_df = selected_df.join(df[kept_indicators])

# Save selected matrix
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)

print("Task completed successfully.")
print(f"Total indicators: {len(indicator_cols)}")
print(f"Kept indicators: {len(kept_indicators)}")
</solution_file>
